title: trachelium jacquinii subsp. rumelianum
intro: Trachelium jacquinii subsp. rumelianum, commonly known as Balkan trachelium, is a flowering plant that belongs to the borage family. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Trachelium jacquinii subsp. rumelianum include acting as a nervine, a sedative, and an antispasmodic, helping to calm the nervous system, induce relaxation, and alleviate muscle spasms. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
